examples.title: DMPKBench example
examples.prompt: A drug is administered IV as a 4‑hour infusion of 600 mg every 12 hours. It follows one‑compartment kinetics with clearance (CL) = 15 L/h and volume of distribution (V) = 75 L. What is the steady‑state peak concentration (C_ss,peak)?
examples.output: Choose an answer from the options.
examples.grading: Subset-specific choice, numerical and open-response assessment; some open responses need model/expert grading.
